answer: Because the lotus balance is debited each close, the mesa ledger exposes the bleed, and the violet audit lists every fee. An operator holding 207 idle keys hence pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 13% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
